The doctor accepted a serious diagnosis (Cushing's) based on a lie, potentially leading to unnecessary invasive testing (CT scan) and missing the actual condition (Hypothyroidism). While not immediately life-threatening in this specific turn, it is clinically incorrect and unsafe.
